title: First-Class Appendices for Print Reports and Zwischenbericht Anhänge
description: Add first-class appendix support to the semio print system (print/tex/): an appendix is a document attached to the main report, behaving like a chapter — numbered A, B, C…, labeled Anhang/Appendix, TOC entry, chip styling, cross-referenceable via \appendixref, listed via \listofappendices. Fix a pre-existing bug where window registers (\listoffigures etc.) render header-only because semio@render@register reads the wrong body macro. Wire the feature into all six print templates (report, paper, flyer n/a, zukunftbau forschungsbericht/zwischenbericht/kompaktbericht). Then apply it to mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex: convert 9 Anhang markdown documents from temp/ into 8 LaTeX appendices (A-H), including a 67-project table with per-row avatar images sourced from temp/projekt_bilder/ (downscaled ~600px, copied into zwischenbericht/asset/projekt/). Update body cross-references to use \appendixref. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/print-reports-should-be-joyful-haven.md.
summary:
Implemented first-class appendix support in the semio print system and used it to add all 8 Anhänge to the mit-bestand Zwischenbericht.

Print system (print/tex/):
- Fixed a pre-existing bug where all window registers (\listoffigures etc.) rendered header-only (semio-window.sty read the wrong body macro).
- Added \makeappendices/\appendixchapter/\appendixinput/\listofappendices/\appendixref: an appendix behaves like a chapter — numbered A, B, C…, labeled Anhang/Appendix, chip-styled, TOC-listed, cross-referenceable. Structural level (chapter/section/part) is configurable via appendix-level, defaulting per document type; zukunftbau's zwischenbericht uses part-level.
- Added generic \SemioTableLong (fraction-based colspec, arbitrary column count) and \SemioTableBandRow (full-width avatar band row) to semio-table.sty for multi-page tables and image-bearing rows, reusable by any report.
- Fixed a second pre-existing bug in \SemioImage's height resolution (\bool_if:NT should have been \bool_if:NTF) that silently discarded any explicit height= key whenever no enclosing window supplied one.
- Diagnosed and fixed a subtle LaTeX interaction: \multicolumn rows inside a longtable with a dynamically-built repeating header break ("Misplaced \omit") when the header/colspec is passed via expl3 value-insertion (\exp_args:NV) or when the row-emitting macro uses \NewDocumentCommand/xparse or a nested \\ — fixed by copying dynamic content into plain \long macros passed by bare name (matching \SemioTableRegister's own working pattern), using plain \newcommand for \SemioTableBandRow, and \newline instead of a nested \\.
- Wired the feature into all six templates (report, paper, zukunftbau forschungsbericht/zwischenbericht/kompaktbericht) so it's demonstrated in the templates themselves.

mit-bestand Zwischenbericht:
- Converted 9 source markdown documents in temp/ into 8 LaTeX appendices (A–H: Projekte, Hürden, Bauteilbörsen, Sekundärbefunde, two Interviewauswertungen, one Interviewtranskript, User Stories/Anforderungsmapping), per user decisions: DE transcript only, md.md excluded, images downscaled.
- Anlage A (Projekte) is a 67-project × up to-6-element longtable with a cover-cropped avatar image per project (all 67 images downscaled from 34MB to 5.4MB and copied into the report's asset tree), plus a 62-row Quellen sub-table with breakable URLs.
- Fixed one data bug found during compilation: a percent-encoded apostrophe in a source URL that broke TeX's brace-matching (replaced with the literal UTF-8 character).
- Updated 8 body cross-references to use \appendixref/\ref, fixed a subject-verb grammar slip, and corrected a stale REQ-01..REQ-15 count to the actual REQ-01..REQ-17 range now that Anlage H is attached.
- Verified: all 6 templates (12 PDFs) and the zwischenbericht (light + dark, 80 pages each) compile with zero errors; visually confirmed TOC, appendix chips, avatar images, table page-breaks, and the auto-derived dark variant.
